name: (07) Mytherceria — 3 Advanced — Master Mytherceria: Absorb the Mind

system.description:
Beyond merely stealing a victim's memories, the master of Mytherceria can borrow living portions of another's psyche, claiming the fruits of his learning for her own. The subject remains able to function throughout, which many of the plundered consider crueler still.

Make eye contact, spend a Willpower Trait and any number of Mental Traits, and initiate a Mental Challenge. If you win, you take a number of Ability Traits from your victim equal to the Mental Traits you spent to activate the power. He loses those Traits as though he had spent them for retests, regaining them normally at the next game session, while you may spend them as if they were your own. Once spent — or at session's end if unused — the stolen Traits return to their rightful owner.
